description: David continues moving through temporary jobs and vulnerable communities, protecting people from exploitation while the unfinished search for a cure survives into the series' final regular episodes.

s05e01.description: David travels with a gifted young baseball pitcher and tries to protect him from an agent determined to control his future.

s05e02.description: Three women escape from prison with David unwillingly along for the ride, and one fugitive's imminent childbirth turns the flight into a rescue mission.

s05e03.description: David uncovers an assassination plot surrounding a decorated Vietnam veteran running for office, but the apparent hero and assassin both hide complications.

s05e04.description: David poses as a priest to protect a young boy who has claimed sanctuary inside a mission from the criminals pursuing him.

s05e05.description: Working as a lumberjack, David falls for a woman also desired by a powerful local tycoon who decides intimidation is simpler than competition.

s05e06.description: David is captured by an escaped convict and former guard and forced into a dangerous mine to dig for hidden gold.

s05e07.description: A deadly gas leak empties a town, leaving David, a scientist and an infected dog to deal with looters inside the quarantine zone.
